text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo Memory was incredible!
Especially that acceleration in the final stretch, what even was that?!
She was out of this world!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
A short-distance prodigy is here!
I wonder if she'll run in the mile races too?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...!
All right... yes, yes, yeeesss!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've grasped it...!
My weapon...!!

I went to greet Bamboo Memory,
who had brilliantly demonstrated her short-distance aptitude—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Oooooooh!!
Traaaiiineeeer-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!
In today's race,
I definitely found my groove!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"My weapon...!
My greatest strength...!!
My potential to become the most awesome Umamusume!"

Bamboo Memory seemed to recognize the budding of
her own potential, and a new flame ignited in her eyes...!
choice_data_list: Next time, let's take on a bigger challenge.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
Does that mean—
choice_data_list: In Senior year, we're taking on the Sprint and Mile G1s!
In Senior year, we're going to take on the Sprint and Mile G1s!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooohh!!
At both the sprint and mile distances!!
choice_data_list: Let's be the strongest and the absolute best at both distances.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!
And the day after the Swan Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—And then, and then!
Which GⅠ are we taking on first?!
When is it?!”
choice_data_list: First, let's set our sights on the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.text:
A race to decide the spring sprint champion.
There, Bamboo Memory's true potential will be proudly displayed to this era...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha!!
The spring championship race to crown the top sprinter...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gaaaaaah!!!
I wanna skip winter and jump straight to spring!!
I can't wait!!
choice_data_list: Let's channel that energy into our training!
Let's channel that energy into our training!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hah...! That's so true!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'll pile up each and every day with everything I've got
and aim for spring!!
So—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Please keep the strict training coming!!"

"Aiming for the top, our challenge begins...!
First up in the spring is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!!"
